card.name: The word percent after a number
card.fires_on: The spelled-out word "percent" right after a numeral, such as 19 or 3.7. It appears in statistics about shares, rates or amounts, in both general web text and drug-label text.

modes.label: Share of a group
modes.description: "percent" after a number, followed by "of" and a group or total.
modes.example: During the Korean Conflict, 19<< percent>> of HNL operations were military.

modes.label: Percent as a modifier
modes.description: "percent" after a number, directly followed by a noun such as reduction or humidity.
modes.example: F figures published in 1998 show a 47<< percent>> reduction in infant and under 5 mortality
